        int maxWordLength = 0;

            } else if (currentChar == '_') {

                        numWords++;

                if (index == length - 1) {
                    maxWordLength = Math.max(maxWordLength, currentWord.length());
                }
            }

        System.out.println(maxWordLength + " " + numWords);
